DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の操作をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like help using the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行き先を家族に確認したいです。後ろに人が並んでいるので、今の画面を終えて順番を譲れますか。まだお金は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行先未確定で未入金操作を取消し順番を譲れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to check my destination with my family. People are queuing behind me, so can I end the current screen and let someone else take a turn? I have not put any money in yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can cancel an operation without inserting money and give up your turn because your destination is undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入していなければ、操作を取り消してから離れてください。画面を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have not bought anything, please cancel the operation before stepping away. We will check the screen together.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。途中の画面を残したまま、次の人に続けてもらうのは違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中画面を次人へ引継がず取消確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. So I should not leave the screen partway through and have the next person continue, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a check of cancellation rather than handing an unfinished screen to the next person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。こちらで取消しができました。最初の画面に戻っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. The operation has now been cancelled here. It is back at the initial screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初に戻りました。家族へ電話する間は列から離れます。戻ったら先頭へ戻らず、最後尾に並び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初期画面確認後離れ最後尾へ並び直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is back at the start. I will leave the queue while phoning my family. When I return, I will join the back rather than go to the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will leave after confirming the initial screen and rejoin the back of the queue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。通話は通行の妨げにならない所でどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do that. Make your call somewhere that does not obstruct people.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 壁際へ移ります。家族には駅名だけでなく、目的地へ行く路線も聞きます。同じ名前の候補を選ばないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 壁際で家族に駅名路線を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move beside the wall. I will ask my family not just the station name but also the line to my destination. I will check so I do not choose another option with the same name.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the station name and line with your family beside the wall. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かったら、購入する前に係員へご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know, you can ask a staff member before purchasing.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認してから並び直します。まだきっぷは買っていないので、取消しを購入済みの払い戻しとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未購入取消と購入後払戻を区別し再購入へ進むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check and then queue again. Since I have not bought a ticket yet, I understand that cancelling this operation is different from a refund for a purchased ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish cancellation before purchase from a refund after purchase, and say you will proceed to buy after checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。それでは、分かりましたらまたお声がけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please ask us again once you know. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 模型についてご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the model?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この模型を見て、実物の高さを知りたいです。模型の高さを定規で測れば、そのまま実物の高さになるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 模型の高さを実物と同じに考えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Looking at this model, I want to know the height of the real object. If I measure the model's height with a ruler, is that directly the height of the real object?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can treat the model's height as the real object's height. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 模型は実物を縮めて表しています。この説明では、実物の百分の一の大きさです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The model represents the real object at a reduced size. According to this explanation, it is one hundredth of the actual size.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百分の一なら、模型の一センチは実物の百センチということですか。数字の意味を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百分の一で一センチ対百センチか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: If it is one hundredth, does one centimeter on the model mean one hundred centimeters on the real object? I want to check what the numbers mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether one centimeter corresponds to one hundred centimeters at a scale of one to one hundred. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その考え方です。ただし、この展示では模型に触れて測らず、説明板の寸法をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is the right idea. However, please do not touch and measure this model; look at the dimensions on the information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明板には模型の高さが三十センチとあります。百倍すると三千センチですね。メートルでは何メートルになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十センチ百倍をメートルに換算したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The board says the model's height is thirty centimeters. Multiplying by one hundred gives three thousand centimeters. How many meters is that?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to convert thirty centimeters multiplied by one hundred into meters. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三千センチは三十メートルです。ここでは説明板に示した部分の高さとして考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Three thousand centimeters is thirty meters. Here, consider that the height of the part indicated on the board.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三十メートルですね。台の高さまで含めた数字ではなく、説明板にある部分だけの高さとしてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三十メートルは台を除く指定部分と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thirty meters, right. I will note it as the height of only the part on the board, rather than a figure that includes the stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that thirty meters refers to the indicated part without the stand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 縮尺と単位を一緒に書くと、後から確かめられますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you write the scale and units together, you can check them later.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「百分の一、模型三十センチ、実物三十メートル」と書きました。家族には、模型の寸法と実物の寸法を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 縮尺と両寸法を記録し家族へ区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote, 'Scale one to one hundred; model thirty centimeters; real object thirty meters.' I will explain the model dimensions and actual dimensions separately to my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the scale and both dimensions, and explain the distinction to your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 計算を確かめられましたね。それでは、ほかの展示もごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have checked the calculation. Please take your time with the other displays too.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お参りしている途中で携帯が何度も鳴りました。家族からの連絡ですが、ここで通話を続けない方がいいですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝中の家族の着信にどう対応するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My phone rang repeatedly while I was worshipping. It is my family contacting me, but it would be better not to keep talking here, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to handle incoming calls from your family during worship. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周りの方に配慮して、通話はお参りの場所から離れてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please be considerate of those around you and make calls away from the place of worship.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。緊急の連絡かだけ画面で確認し、返事は通路をふさがない所でします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 緊急度を画面で確認し離れて返事すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will just check the screen to see whether it is urgent and reply somewhere that does not block the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will check urgency on the screen and move away to reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知音を切っておくと安心ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be reassuring to turn off notification sounds.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 音は切ったつもりでしたが、アラームが残っていました。参拝が終わるまで、そのアラームも止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残ったアラームも止めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I had turned the sound off, but an alarm was still active. I will stop that alarm too until I finish worshipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will stop the remaining alarm too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面を見る間は、立ち止まってくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please stop walking while looking at the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩きながら操作していました。ここで端に寄って止めます。家族にも、少し後で電話すると短く送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立ち止まって後で電話すると家族へ送ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was operating it while walking. I will move to the side and stop here. I will also send my family a short message saying I will call a little later.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stop walking and message your family that you will call later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その後は、落ち着いてお参りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After that, you can worship calmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送れました。携帯をかばんへしまい、お参りを済ませてから家族にかけ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯をしまい参拝後にかけ直すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have sent it. I will put the phone in my bag and call my family back after finishing worship.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put your phone away and call back after worship. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ静かにお参りください。それでは、よい一日をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please worship quietly. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示の夜景写真について、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the night-view photograph on display?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この白い線は道路に描かれた模様ですか。今窓から見る道路には同じ線がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜景写真の白線が道路模様か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Are these white lines a pattern painted on the road? The road I can see from the window now does not have the same lines.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the white lines in the night photograph are road patterns. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真では、動く車のライトが長い線として写っています。道路の模様ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: In the photograph, the lights of moving cars appear as long lines. They are not patterns on the road.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車の光なのですね。一台の車が長い棒の形をしている、という意味でもないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 光線が長棒形車そのものではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So they are car lights. Does that also mean a single car is not actually shaped like a long rod?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the light trail is not a car itself shaped like a long rod. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。時間をかけて光を写したため、動いた道筋が線になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Because the light was photographed over time, the path it traveled appears as a line.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真は一瞬を見たままとは違うのですね。赤い線も、車の後ろのライトが動いた道筋と考えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時間をかけた撮影と赤線の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: So a photograph is different from seeing just one instant as it is. Can I understand the red lines as the paths of moving rear lights too?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about photographing over time and the meaning of the red lines. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この写真の赤い線は、その説明になっています。窓からの景色では車が動く様子をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is how the red lines in this photograph are explained. Please watch the cars moving in the view from the window.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は小さい光が移動するのが見えます。展示写真の線と、実際の一台ずつの光を見比べてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓の動く点と展示線を比較すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see small lights moving now. I will compare the lines in the exhibition photograph with the lights of individual real cars.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the moving points outside the window with the lines on display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真の説明文にも、写し方を紹介しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The photograph's caption also introduces how it was taken.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明文も読みます。友人には、窓の道路に線がないから写真が偽物、とは言わず、写した時間の違いだと話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写す時間の違いとして友人へ説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read the caption too. Rather than tell my friend the photograph is fake because the road outside has no lines, I will explain that the difference is the duration of the photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the difference in exposure duration to your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 景色と写真の違いを楽しんでください。それでは、ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy the differences between the view and the photograph. Please take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これから体温を測ります。準備はよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will take your temperature now. Are you ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前に伝えたいことがあります。待っている間に熱いお茶を飲みました。飲んだ時刻を言った方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検温前に熱い茶を飲み時刻が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is something I want to tell you first. I drank hot tea while waiting. Should I tell you when I drank it?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before temperature measurement, say you drank hot tea and ask whether the time is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ頃、どのくらい飲みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: About when, and how much did you drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五分ほど前に、紙コップ半分です。冷たい水を飲んだと言い間違えないよう、熱いお茶だったと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五分前半杯の熱い茶と具体的に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: About five minutes ago, half a paper cup. I want to make clear it was hot tea, without mistakenly saying I drank cold water.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specifically report half a cup of hot tea five minutes ago. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 測り方や、いつ測るかは、こちらで確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check how and when to measure your temperature and explain it to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。お茶を飲んだから熱がない、と自分で判断するわけではありません。朝からだるかったことも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲茶から熱の有無を判断せず朝のだるさも伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I am not deciding for myself that I do not have a fever because I drank tea. I also want to tell you I have felt sluggish since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid deciding whether you have a fever from drinking tea and mention your sluggishness since morning too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: だるさは、いつから感じていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When did you start feeling sluggish?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝起きた時からです。飲む前から感じていました。お茶を飲んだ時刻と、だるくなった時刻は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲茶とだるさ開始を別時刻として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Since waking up this morning. I felt it before drinking the tea. The time I drank tea and the time the sluggishness began are separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that drinking tea and the start of sluggishness occurred at different times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二つを記録します。測定の案内があるまで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record both. Please wait here until we explain the measurement.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分で飲み物の分を引いて体温を報告せず、案内された方法で測り、結果を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 体温を自己補正せず指定測定で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not subtract an amount for the drink myself and report an adjusted temperature. I will use the method you instruct and check the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check using the instructed measurement without adjusting your temperature yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を教えていただきありがとうございました。それでは、準備ができるまでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us the circumstances. Please wait until we are ready. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防犯教室についてのお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the crime-prevention class?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。近所の人と参加しますが、家の防犯について人前で住所を話したくありません。質問だけ紙で出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公開教室で住所を伏せ紙質問できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am attending with a neighbor, but I do not want to discuss my address in front of others when asking about home security. Can I submit just my question on paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can keep your address private and submit a paper question at the public class. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の教室では、一般的な質問を紙で受け付ける予定です。個別の被害相談は別に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this class, we plan to accept general questions on paper. We will hear consultations about specific incidents separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ被害はありません。夜、玄関で荷物を受け取るときの注意を、住所なしで聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 被害相談ではなく玄関受取の一般的注意と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nothing has happened to me yet. I want to ask about precautions when receiving a delivery at the entrance at night, without giving an address.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it is a general question about receiving deliveries at the entrance, not a consultation about an incident. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その内容なら、名前や住所を書かず、場面を短く説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: For that topic, briefly describe the situation without writing your name or address.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「一人で帰宅した直後、配達の人が来た場合」と書きます。家の間取りの写真は付けないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 匿名の場面文を書き間取写真を付けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write, 'When a delivery person arrives just after I return home alone.' I will not attach a photograph of my home's layout.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will write an anonymous description of the situation without attaching a layout photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの参加者にも分かる一般的な説明にしておきますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will keep the explanation general so other participants can understand it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。もし答えを聞いて自分の家について詳しく相談したくなったら、教室の後に個別に聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 教室後の個別相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. If the answer makes me want to discuss my own home in more detail, can I ask privately after the class?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to consult privately after the class. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その際は、担当者に相談方法をご確認ください。教室中の公開質問と分けて扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: In that case, please check with the person in charge about how to consult them. We will handle it separately from public questions during the class.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は匿名の質問だけ用意し、個別の事情は皆さんの前では話さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 匿名質問と個別事情を分けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Today I will prepare only an anonymous question and avoid discussing my individual circumstances in front of everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate anonymous questions from personal circumstances. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 安心してご参加ください。それでは、当日お待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please feel comfortable attending. We look forward to seeing you on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 試着はいかがでしたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着は買いたいです。ただ、私が着て来たストールも店の物だと思って、かごに入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 私物ストールを商品かごに混ぜたと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy the jacket. But I thought the stole I wore here was also store merchandise and put it in the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mixed your own stole into the merchandise basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身のストールですね。こちらで商品と分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is your own stole, correct? Let's separate it from the merchandise.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この灰色の物です。上着には値札がありますが、ストールは私の持ち物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 灰色私物と値札付上着を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this gray one. The jacket has a price tag, but the stole is my own possession.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your own gray item from the jacket with a price tag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上着だけお会計に回します。ストールはすぐお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will send only the jacket to checkout. Will you use the stole right away?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外が寒いので首に巻きます。タグを探すために広げず、そのまま返していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ストールを広げず返してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is cold outside, so I will wrap it around my neck. Could you return it as it is, without spreading it out to search for a tag?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to have the stole returned without spreading it out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。ほかに試着された商品はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here you are. Did you try on any other merchandise?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い上着も着ましたが、そちらは戻します。買うのはこの黒い上着一着だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青は戻し黒一着を買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also tried on a blue jacket, but I will return that one. I am buying only this one black jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return the blue jacket and buy one black jacket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 黒い上着一着ですね。レジへご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: One black jacket, correct. I will show you to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私物を分けてくださってありがとうございます。ストールは身に着けたので、かごには黒い上着しか残っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 私物を身に着けかごの購入品を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you for separating my own item. I have put the stole on, so only the black jacket remains in the basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put on your own item and confirm the item to buy in the basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでお会計を承ります。それでは、どうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your payment here. Please come this way. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの貝をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which shellfish are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に頼まれた名前を覚えて来ましたが、発音に自信がありません。「しじみ」と「しじみい」は同じ物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貝名の末尾を長く言うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I memorized the name my family asked for, but I am not confident about the pronunciation. Are 'shijimi' and 'shijimii' the same thing?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to lengthen the end of the shellfish name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「しじみ」です。最後に長い「い」は付けません。こちらの小さい貝ですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is 'shijimi.' There is no long 'i' added at the end. These are the small clams here.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: しじみ、ですね。今、口で言って確認できました。家族のメモにも「しじみ」と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: しじみと復唱し家族メモと一致を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Shijimi, right. I have now confirmed it by saying it aloud. My family's note also says 'shijimi.'
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Repeat 'shijimi' and say it matches your family's note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのメモの量も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know the quantity on that note too?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二百グラムです。二百個という意味ではなく、重さで二百グラムお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 個数でなく二百グラムを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two hundred grams. I do not mean two hundred clams; please give me two hundred grams by weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request two hundred grams rather than a number of clams. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 重さで量ります。調理方法はご家族がご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will weigh them. Does your family know how to cook them?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族が汁を作ります。私は種類と量だけ確認して買い、下処理は帰宅してから家族に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 種類量だけ購入し下処理は家族に聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family will make soup. I will buy them after checking only the type and amount, and ask my family about preparation when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will buy after checking only type and amount and ask your family about preparation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 量れました。こちらが二百グラムです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: They have been weighed. This is two hundred grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これをお願いします。電話で家族に「しじみを二百グラム買った」と伝えてから、受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入内容を電話で報告し受け取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take these. I will tell my family on the phone, 'I bought two hundred grams of shijimi,' and then collect them.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report the purchase by phone and then collect it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをお持ちください。お買い上げありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take these. Thank you for your purchase. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市へのご意見についてのご案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like guidance on giving feedback to the city?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この意見募集に賛成と書きたいです。困ったことがある人だけ書く欄でしょうか。よかった点も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 意見募集に肯定的評価も書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to write that I support this proposal in the call for opinions. Is the space only for people who have had problems? I also want to mention the good points.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can write a positive evaluation in the call for opinions too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 賛成のご意見もお書きいただけます。どの案についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write supportive opinions too. Which proposal is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内板の文字を大きくする案です。父が小さい文字を読みづらそうにしていたので、役立つと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文字大型化に賛成する父の経験を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: The proposal to enlarge the lettering on information boards. My father seemed to have difficulty reading small letters, so I think it will help.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your father's experience as the reason for supporting larger lettering. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身がそう考える理由を、具体的に書くと伝わりやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Writing your own reasons specifically will make your opinion easier to understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父の病名ではなく、今の案内板で文字を読むのに時間がかかった、と書きます。父の名前は書かなくてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 病名や父名を出さず経験を書くと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than my father's diagnosis, I will write that reading the lettering on the current boards took time. Is it all right not to write his name?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about writing the experience without giving a diagnosis or your father's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族の名前を理由の欄に書く必要はありません。投稿者の情報は、募集の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: You do not need to write a family member's name in the reason section. Please check the call-for-opinions instructions about the submitter's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は自分の連絡先の欄を確認します。大きくするだけでなく、文字と背景の色にも配慮してほしいという希望を追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人情報を確認し文字背景色の希望を加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the field for my own contact details. I also want to add a request to consider the colors of the lettering and background, not only enlarge the letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check your own information and add a request about lettering and background colors. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望と賛成の理由を分けて書けば、内容が分かりやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your message will be clearer if you write your request separately from your reason for supporting the proposal.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上に賛成の理由、下に色についての希望を書きます。提出先と締切は、この案内で確かめてから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 理由と希望を分け締切提出先を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put my reason for supporting it above and my request about colors below. I will check the submission destination and deadline in these instructions before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate reasons and requests and check the deadline and submission destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご意見をお寄せください。それでは、案内をお持ち帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please send us your feedback. Take these instructions home with you. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご案内の中で、分かりにくい言葉はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were there any words in the guidance that were difficult to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「のうふ」と聞こえましたが、農業をする人のことではないですよね。税金の話なので、意味を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 納付を農夫と聞違え意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard 'nōfu,' but it does not mean a farmer, does it? Since we are discussing taxes, I want to check the meaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the meaning of '納付' after confusing it with '農夫,' a farmer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでは「納付」と言いました。税金などを納めることです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, I said '納付'—making a payment, such as paying taxes.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 税金などを納めることなのですね。音だけだと農夫と混ざってしまいました。漢字で書いて見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 税金等を納める意味を復唱し漢字表示を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it means paying taxes and the like. Hearing only the sound, I confused it with '農夫,' a farmer. Could you write the kanji and show me?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Repeat the meaning of paying taxes and the like, and request the kanji in writing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに「納付」と書きます。「お金を納める」とも説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will write '納付' here. It can also be explained as 'paying money.'

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 漢字で分かりました。私のメモには読み方と「お金を納める」の両方を書きます。手続きを知らせることとは別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 漢字読みと平易語をメモし手続届出との違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: The kanji makes it clear. I will write both the pronunciation and 'paying money' in my notes. Is it different from notifying someone of a procedure?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Note the kanji, pronunciation and plain explanation, and ask how it differs from notification of a procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 言葉の意味は別です。実際に必要な手続きとお支払いは、相談内容に合わせて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: The words have different meanings. Please check the procedures and payments actually required according to your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。「納付」という言葉が分かっただけで、私の支払いが済んだわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 語の理解と実際の支払完了を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Just because I understand the word '納付' does not mean my payment is complete, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish understanding the word from actual completion of payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今日はまず、どのご案内をお持ちか伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Today, we will first ask which guidance you have brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この封書の案内を見てください。言葉の意味を確認できたので、次は私に必要な手続きと支払いの説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封書を示し自分に必要な手続支払説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please look at the guidance in this envelope. Now that I have checked the word's meaning, I would next like to hear about the procedures and payments I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and request an explanation of the procedures and payments you need. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。それでは、封書をお持ちになってこちらへどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you to the person in charge. Please bring the envelope and come this way. Goodbye.
